title: A scalar interface reduction for nonlinear interface problems
summary: We study finite element approximations of elliptic and parabolic interface problems with discontinuous coefficients and nonlinear jump conditions. We introduce a scalar interface reduction in which the solution is decomposed into a continuous component and a unit-jump response mode. This representation isolates the interface nonlinearity into a single scalar variable while the bulk problem remains linear.
